title_formula_note: Relabelled T2 -> T9 by the creative director on 2026-10-25 (growth memo 2026-10-25 section 5): the title is a single-animal kill title with a revelation clause ('How [X] Kills Doug Without ...'), the T9 'How' variant, with no 'Every [Set]' scope, so it is not a test of the dropped T2 list formula. Its day-7 counts toward T9. Original packaging note: Chosen: T2 'How [X] Kills' with the revelation clause 'Without Chasing Him'. It keeps the CD's T10 promise (decisions.md 2026-10-18) but drops 'Why', which the brief section 1 says the CD prefers, so it does not open like 021 ('Why Orcas Kill Everything in the Ocean Except Doug'). It has no 'Everything', 'Except' or 'Refuses'. Rule check: (1) 52 chars, 9 words; (2) Title Case, no caps, emoji, ! or ?; (3) T2; (4) one death verb, 'Kills', no dread adjective; (5) revelation clause 'Without Chasing Him'; (6) no 'in N Minutes', no leading count; (7) no word shared with the planned thumbnail text 'IT CAN WAIT' (that is also why the CD's 'Why the Komodo Dragon Can Kill Doug Without Chasing Him' is not the lead: 'Can' would repeat the thumbnail); (9) 5 candidates; (10) not a Paint Explainer title or noun swap. Doug is in the title. Honest: every item is a reason the dragon doesn't need to chase, and none of Doug's 8 deaths is a chase (ambush, scent, walking-pace follow, crowd, wait). The title says 'without chasing him', not 'can't run'; item 1 says it can sprint. Alternates: T10 phrasing of the CD's lead with no 'Can' (the best A/B test against the lead); T2 'Every Stage' scope version; T4 revelation (field researchers found the largest dragons sit and wait); T3 'Every Step' scope. Rejected: 'Deadliest Lizard' (not sourced), 'The Komodo Dragon Doesn't Chase Doug. It Waits.' (no dread word or death verb, and 'Waits' repeats the thumbnail), 'Everything a Komodo Dragon Does Instead of Chasing Doug' (021 echo through 'Everything', no death verb). T1 is held per the 10-18 memo, and T6 was used in 020.
thumbnail_brief: Archetype C hero: one huge, heavy, hard-eyed Komodo (detailed cartoon tier, low profile, claws, forked tongue out, never cute, no fantasy wings or fire) lying flat and perfectly still across a flat sand-tan background, one eye tracking tiny Doug as he walks away whistling with a small white bandage on his ankle (no red, no wound), so the title's 'kills without chasing' meets an image of a predator that hasn't moved yet; text 'IT CAN WAIT' at most, and never a title or alt-title word (How, Why, Komodo, Komodo's, Dragon, Dragons, Kills, Kill, Doug, Chasing, Chase, Need, Die, Every, Stage, Step, Hunt, Creepiest, Weapon, Scientists, Found, Patience, Most, Disturbing, Habits); B test: 3x3 grid labelled AMBUSH / TEETH / TONGUE / FOLLOW / SWIM / CROWD / BUFFALO / NURSERY plus a stopwatch tile labelled 4,000,000 YR.
description:
How does a Komodo dragon hunt deer, wild boar and water buffalo when it almost never has to chase them? Doug finds out on the Indonesian islands of Komodo, Rinca and Flores, from the ambush beside the trail to fossils about four million years old.

Where should we send Doug next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you're here for Doug's next bad idea.
